snippet.title: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4243990/Path_of_Idle_Old_Gods_Rising

A Lovecraftian idle RPG with auto-battles, loot farming, chests, team strategy, town building, gear crafting, Runewords, stages, towers, realms, and seasons. Serve the Old Gods, build your town, corrupt the chosen, and fight for their awakening!

Developed by
Small Mill
